blockers.description: The final scripts/check-in-container.sh run emitted partial all-green output but its terminal exit code and final marker were not captured. Its process is no longer discoverable, and the original tool session is unavailable.
blockers.workaround: Rerun the pinned container gate or otherwise capture a terminal exit 0 and its final success marker before reporting container parity.

decisions.decision: D-03b: unchanged recorded checkpoints auto-decide only in Auto mode; Supervise receives a human Code gate.
decisions.rationale: This closes the unconditional D-03 exception that contradicted Supervise semantics.

decisions.decision: A rejected Auto re-scan parks the phase in Supervise, preserves the prior approval, and requires repair plus explicit resume.
decisions.rationale: A rejected agent-authored checkpoint must not be auto-decided or silently discarded.

decisions.decision: Recovery commands may attribute an answered gate to a waiter only when observed and current live lock holders have the same pid and start time.
decisions.rationale: PID reuse, successor holders, and unconfirmable holders fail closed.

decisions.decision: Ship's stored-response recovery exception is limited to NoHolder; Recycled is never treated as a waiting holder.
decisions.rationale: A recycled PID is not evidence that a process will consume a response.

decisions.decision: Formal security review used Verify all threats and returned SECURED at the configured high threshold.
decisions.rationale: T-48-07-02 and T-48-15-01 were rechecked after the class-level remediation; 48-SECURITY.md now records threats_open: 0.
